test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is considered an important factor in determining the quality of diesel fuel?
solution:
The correct answer is __Cetane number.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cetane number__ is a measure of the combustion quality of diesel fuel during compression ignition.
 
• It is an important parameter used to indicate the performance and quality of diesel fuel.
 
• The higher the cetane number, the better the fuel's combustion.
 
• A high cetane number ensures smooth engine operation, reduced noise, and lower emissions.
 
• It is particularly significant for diesel engines, where fuel combustion directly impacts performance.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Octane Number:**

 
 
• Octane number is used to measure the performance of gasoline (petrol) in spark-ignition engines.
 
• It is not related to diesel fuel quality.
 
 
 
• **Viscosity:**
 
 
• Viscosity is the measure of a fluid's resistance to flow.
 
• It is important for lubricants but is not a primary indicator of diesel fuel quality.
 
 
 
• **Flash Point:**
 
 
• Flash point is the lowest temperature at which a liquid can vaporize to form an ignitable mixture in air.
 
• It is used for safety assessments rather than performance quality.
